actions.creativePromptImageStart: Layla, help me prepare a strong image-generation prompt. Start with one grouped checklist of missing details. If I attach a reference, analyze what is visible, then show a preserve/change plan and wait for my approval before writing the final prompt. Do not generate media.
actions.creativePromptVideoStart: Layla, help me prepare a strong video-generation prompt. Start with one grouped checklist of missing details, including duration, shot progression, camera/motion, transitions, audio, dialogue, on-screen text, and ending when relevant. If I attach a reference, analyze what is visible, then show a preserve/change plan and wait for my approval before writing the final prompt. Do not generate media.
actions.imageProviderMissing: The image generator is not configured. Ask the workspace owner to set the image provider and its key in Settings → Admin → Connectors → Image generation. The system never returns placeholder images.

launch.title: Review and confirm
launch.desc: Check the campaign summary and the ad details that customers will see.
launch.pausedOnly: After your confirmation, Meta objects are created as PAUSED. They will not be delivered or spend budget until separately enabled.
launch.settingsIntro: The workspace owner manages the Meta account and Facebook Page. Technical values are derived automatically from the campaign objective, so you never have to enter them.
launch.assistHint: Read the campaign strategy and current wizard values, then check Meta field context and available enums.
launch.assistNeedsStrategy: Generate the campaign strategy first to use this assistant.
launch.assistNeedsConnection: Connect Meta before requesting live field context.
launch.assistContextReady: Meta Ads MCP field context was retrieved; exact enum values are checked when available.

launch.assistDraftOnly: Suggestions are applied to editable draft fields. No Meta objects are created here; review them before continuing.
launch.advancedDescription: These platform-level values are for an administrator. Do not guess them; an incorrect value can make Meta reject the campaign or change its targeting.
launch.aiPrefilledBanner: Campaign details automatically pre-filled by AI — review and approve to launch.
launch.requiresMeta: Ask the workspace owner to configure the Meta access token, ad account ID, and Facebook Page ID in Settings → Admin → Connectors → Meta.
launch.completeRequired: Some campaign details still need attention. Check the fields below.
launch.savedNoWrite: Saved locally only. No Meta request has been made and no ad object exists yet.
launch.retrySafeHint: The failed attempt created no Meta objects. This retries with the saved campaign details.
launch.resumeSafeHint: The campaign already exists on Meta in PAUSED state. This continues at ad set creation without creating a duplicate campaign.
